global_style.image_style_suffix: flat cel-shaded illustration, bold clean outlines, limited palette of muted desaturated colours with a single saturated accent, hard-edged shadows, no gradients, no photographic texture, video game key art
characters.laura.visual_prompt: beautiful woman in her forties, dark hair pulled back untidily, worn work jacket, backpack, face marked by exhaustion
characters.mark.visual_prompt: man past forty, lean, an interesting face, thinning hair and short beard, work coat, moves with the calm of someone who has done this before
characters.tommy.visual_prompt: young man of twenty-two at most, thin, oversized hoodie, restless nervous hands, looks younger than he is
characters.cane_robot.visual_prompt: Boston Dynamics style robotic quadruped, about fifty centimetres tall, smooth faceless body, sensors where the eyes would be, thin articulated limbs; moves with the inertia of a real animal, accelerates badly and brakes worse; one LED on the right flank and a launch hatch
places.magazzino_interno.visual_prompt: abandoned logistics warehouse, banded darkness with dusty shafts of light from broken skylights, eight-metre steel racking, long aisles fading into the dark, concrete floor strewn with debris
places.bosco_albero.visual_prompt: sparse deciduous woodland, grey trunks and dry undergrowth; one forked tree thicker than the rest, with two branches meeting five metres up
places.villa_esterno.visual_prompt: isolated villa at the end of a valley, expensive linear architecture: concrete, floor-to-ceiling glazing, flat roof covered in photovoltaic panels; around it a lawn of tall grass uncut for years and a stone patio
places.villa_soggiorno.visual_prompt: large living room with floor-to-ceiling glazing, pale modular sofa under a layer of dust, dry leaves on the floor, open kitchen at the far end, flat daylight entering along a whole wall
places.villa_bagno.visual_prompt: narrow master bathroom, pale tiles, bathtub under a small high window, porcelain basin with a large mirror, a wall socket with a plastic flap beside the mirror, dropped ceiling with a square access panel above the basin
places.villa_pianerottolo.visual_prompt: internal concrete and timber staircase with a metal handrail and an open stairwell, landing on the upper floor, ceiling with an inspection hatch and a dangling cord
places.villa_studio.visual_prompt: small room with a pale wooden desk, a low bookcase, a window onto the patio, drawers full of household paperwork
places.villa_garage.visual_prompt: underground garage with an electric saloon car under a dust sheet, a workbench cluttered with jars, a wall charger, an orange cable reel hanging
items.walkie_talkie.visual_prompt: site walkie-talkie in worn yellow plastic, short rubber antenna, dead LCD display
items.medicinali.visual_prompt: blister packs of pills in foil and plastic, dented cardboard boxes with no legible brand
items.chiave_armadietto.visual_prompt: flat brass locker key with a stamped number
items.caramelle.visual_prompt: packet of striped hard sweets, glossy wrapper slightly dusty
items.scatola_bianca.visual_prompt: flat white cardboard box, like a shoebox but shallower, unmarked, dented corners
items.coltello.visual_prompt: work knife with a flick blade and a worn black rubber handle
items.tracker.visual_prompt: tiny metal cylinder the size of a grain of rice, held between two blood-smeared fingers
items.chiave_casa.visual_prompt: modern house key with a hardware shop cardboard tag tied on with string
items.fucile.visual_prompt: over-and-under double-barrelled hunting shotgun, dark wooden stock, blued steel
items.nastro_isolante.visual_prompt: half-used roll of black insulating tape, the end lifted
items.cavo_spellato.visual_prompt: orange electrical cable cut clean through, two bare copper wires at one end, a schuko plug at the other
scenes.auto_in_viaggio.background.image_: from inside an old station wagon: windscreen dirty with dust and dead insects, beyond the glass a cracked country road with grass in the fissures, flat horizon, white midday light
scenes.auto_in_viaggio.narration.1.image: car interior seen from the front through the windscreen: Tommy in the driver's seat on the left, both hands on the only steering wheel; Mark in the front passenger seat on the right, nothing in front of him but the dashboard; Laura on the rear bench behind them, forehead against the side window, all three silent
scenes.piazzale_magazzino.background.ima: forecourt of an abandoned logistics warehouse in open countryside, fence knocked down, empty trailers lined up like ribs, a small annexed shop with a dusty sign, the station wagon parked with the engine off
scenes.spaccio.background.image_prompt: interior of a small abandoned company shop: two dusty half-empty shelves, a desk with a cash register, a metal filing cabinet and a wall locker, grey light through the dirty window
scenes.magazzino_ricerca.background.imag: two torch beams shaking down an aisle between towering racking, banded darkness, dusty shafts of light from broken skylights far above
scenes.pov_magazzino.background.image_pr: a machine's point of view: everything shifted to a blurred organic red, no sharp outlines, shapes melting into one another, a human face reduced to a paler smear; overlaid, minimal and crisp, the only thing in focus in the frame: a lock reticle and a distance in metres. Decentred optics, heavy diffusion in front of the lens, a single colour channel
scenes.pov_magazzino.narration.2.image_p: the same red vision, the lock reticle now tight on the pale smear filling the frame, the distance figure beneath it
scenes.magazzino_attacco.background.imag: at the top of a racking unit, Cane-robot folded and snapping open into four limbs; below, Mark beginning to fall backwards into the dark, his dropped torch lighting him from underneath
scenes.magazzino_attacco.narration.1.ima: from low and to one side: Cane-robot landed on Mark's chest as he lies on the ground, its legs seeking purchase on the concrete, the fallen torch raking light across
scenes.magazzino_attacco.narration.3.ima: Laura's hand snatching a flat white cardboard box off the floor while her body is already moving, motion blur
scenes.magazzino_fuga.background.image_p: low first-person run down an aisle of racking, columns of light sweeping over the camera one after another, the end of the aisle still dark
scenes.rampa_di_carico.background.image_: exterior day, extreme backlight: Laura running out of the darkness of a loading bay into the white of the forecourt, a white van idling and Tommy in the driver's seat who does not understand
scenes.strada_di_campagna.background.ima: shot from inside the van towards the wing mirror: in the mirror, Cane-robot running low on the tarmac and gaining ground; beyond the windscreen a straight country road
scenes.furgone_interno.background.image_: van cabin interior at speed, shot from the passenger seat: the sheet metal roof above Tommy's head deformed downwards, a clean hole punched in the metal, Tommy at the wheel swerving
scenes.furgone_interno.narration.1.image: extreme close-up of the inner roof of a van: a metal spike piercing the sheet metal from above, withdrawing and punching through again a finger's width along, in a row like a stamp
scenes.furgone_ribaltato.background.imag: interior of a cabin rolled onto its side in a drainage ditch: the world at ninety degrees, Laura hanging from her seatbelt, dust suspended in the shaft of light from the cracked windscreen, Tommy motionless beside her
scenes.fosso.background.image_prompt: exterior day, open countryside: Laura crawling out on all fours through the rear window of a van rolled into a drainage ditch, then breaking into a run through dry grass
scenes.fosso.narration.1.image_prompt: Cane-robot circling the wreck of the van at an even pace, in the background Laura running away
scenes.fosso.narration.2.image_prompt: a low dry-stone wall in the middle of a field, Laura throwing her whole body down behind it
scenes.muretto_a_secco.background.image_: behind a dry-stone wall, low tight framing: Laura pressed against the stones, back to the wall, chest rising and falling too fast; above the wall nothing but white sky
scenes.muretto_a_secco.narration.1.image: a sharp low explosion against the far side of a dry-stone wall, stone splinters in the air, Laura curled up shielding her head
scenes.campagna_aperta.background.image_: open field with no cover at all, very low horizon, Laura running with a limp in the foreground and, far behind her, Cane-robot walking
scenes.campagna_aperta.narration.1.image: compressed telephoto: Cane-robot walking across a field, even pace, no hurry
scenes.bosco_ingresso.background.image_p: inside sparse woodland, afternoon light cutting in blades between the trunks, Laura limping forward among the trees, looking back
from below: Laura wedged between two branches five metres up, motionless, sunset light crossing the wood almost horizontally
scenes.bosco_albero_tramonto.narration.1: close-up of Laura leaning against a branch, her eyes closing and snapping open again, her hand gripping the bark
scenes.bosco_albero_tramonto.narration.3: from below, almost dark: Cane-robot unfolding with a snap at the foot of the tree and raising its sensors upwards, one LED lit on its flank
scenes.pov_bosco_notte.background.image_: a machine's point of view, at night: dark red close to black, everything out of focus, among the branches a denser area pulsing slowly to the rhythm of breathing; bottom left, minimal and crisp, a percentage
scenes.pov_bosco_notte.narration.2.image: the same red night vision, unchanged; only the percentage figure at bottom left has changed by one
scenes.bosco_albero_notte.background.ima: deep night in the wood, almost entirely black: only Laura's silhouette wedged between two branches is readable and, far below, a small LED blinking on the flank of Cane-robot folded on the ground
scenes.bosco_alba.background.image_promp: first grey light in the wood, Laura sitting on the ground at the foot of a forked tree, back against the trunk, left leg stretched out in front of her; there is no one else under the tree
scenes.crinale.background.image_prompt: Laura standing on top of a grassy ridge, seen from behind, wide shot; below, in the valley, an isolated villa with wide glazing and a flat roof covered in panels
scenes.viale_accesso.background.image_pr: driveway of a modern villa: a small car parked crooked with its doors open for years, grass in the joints of the concrete, at the far end the front door and a glass wall
scenes.soggiorno_arrivo.background.image: large living room seen from the entrance, flat daylight from a wall of glass, dust over everything, dry leaves blown in through the door, a pale modular sofa
scenes.camera_da_letto.background.image_: master bedroom with light filtered through lowered shutters; on the bed, under the duvet, two shapes that have been still for a very long time; on the nightstand two glasses and an empty bottle
scenes.soggiorno_carica.background.image: Laura sitting on the floor with her back to the wall, the shotgun resting across her knees, in front of her the glass wall and the empty valley, full light
scenes.corridoio_vetrato.background.imag: internal corridor with one wall entirely glazed onto the patio; Laura with her back to the wall and the shotgun raised; beyond the glass, a metre from her, Cane-robot standing still with its sensors turned towards the pane
scenes.corridoio_vetrato.narration.1.ima: close-up through dirty glass: the blind muzzle of Cane-robot centimetres from the surface, the reflection of Laura holding a shotgun
scenes.scale.background.image_prompt: internal concrete and timber staircase shot from below, Laura climbing two steps at a time with a shotgun in her hand, the landing above in shadow
scenes.bagno_primo.background.image_prom: master bathroom seen from the bathtub: the closed door barricaded with a cabinet and a laundry basket, Laura with her back against the wood, shotgun in hand; above the basin, in the dropped ceiling, a square access panel with two wing screws
scenes.bagno_primo.narration.1.image_pro: close-up of the lower part of a pale wooden door: a metal spike piercing it from outside, withdrawing and starting again a finger's width along, in a row like a stamp
scenes.controsoffitto.background.image_p: inside a dropped ceiling: darkness, suspended dust, the silver ventilation duct, Laura crawling forward on her elbows in a space forty centimetres high, lit only by the light rising from the opening behind her
scenes.studio.background.image_prompt: small tidy room: pale wooden desk with a photo frame, a low bookcase, a window onto the patio with full daylight
scenes.soggiorno_ritorno.background.imag: the same living room, now with the glass wall smashed through: shards across the floor, leaves blowing in, the sofa untouched, full light; no one in frame
scenes.lavanderia.background.image_promp: windowless utility room: washing machine, sink, shelves; on the far wall an open industrial consumer unit with two levers and a yellow triangular sticker, below it a battery cabinet
scenes.pianerottolo.background.image_pro: upper floor landing, ceiling damaged by a shotgun blast: crumbled plasterboard on the floor and a severed cord dangling three metres up, out of reach; three doors around it and the stairwell open onto the drop
scenes.tetto.background.image_prompt: flat roof of a modern villa: twelve photovoltaic panels in rows of six, four summers of leaves and bird droppings, white sky; on one panel a fallen branch and glass cracked into a spiderweb
scenes.soggiorno_casa_sveglia.background: in the darkness of a living room, a small black glass wall panel lighting up: a white light, an icon, a temperature; the rest of the room barely readable
scenes.garage.background.image_prompt: underground garage with the service light on for the first time in years: an electric saloon under a dust sheet, a workbench cluttered with jars, a wall charger, an orange cable reel hanging
scenes.bagno_finale.background.image_pro: the same bathroom, now with no door: a row of holes crosses it from side to side and the wood around them is crumbling; the bath and basin taps left running, a film of water spreading across the tiles
scenes.pov_bagno.background.image_prompt: a machine's point of view: red, everything out of focus; a door punched through like a grid of paler blotches and, beyond it, a small room; high against the wall a still, sharp warm mass; overlaid and crisp, a lock reticle, a distance and a percentage
scenes.pov_bagno.narration.2.image_promp: the same red vision, the lock reticle tight on the warm mass up high; below it, other pale patches that were not there before — the warm walls of a house switched back on
scenes.bagno_ingresso_cane.background.im: flooded bathroom seen from above the basin: Cane-robot standing on the broken threshold, sensors turned upwards; the film of water covering every tile catches the light
scenes.bagno_ingresso_cane.narration.1.i: extreme close-up of Cane-robot's right flank as it walks through shallow water: the unseated plate lifting with every step and dirty water getting in and not coming out
scenes.bagno_arco.background.image_promp: flooded bathroom, everything white with light: beneath the film of water a blue electrical arc that stays lit and does not flicker, the room overexposed; Laura crouched on top of the porcelain basin, both feet up on the rim, clear of the water below, pressed against the mirror with both hands flat on the glass; Cane-robot standing in the water on the tiles below her
scenes.bagno_arco.narration.1.image_prom: close-up of Cane-robot gone rigid, limbs straight, black smoke rising from an open plate on its flank, blue reflections in the water around it
scenes.bagno_arco.narration.3.image_prom: Laura standing on a basin, back and hands against a large mirror, her heel slipping on the porcelain; below her the room is white with light
scenes.bagno_arco.narration.4.image_prom: near total darkness in a flooded bathroom, only the grey reflection of the small window on the still water
scenes.bagno_dopo.background.image_promp: dark flooded bathroom: Laura standing motionless on the basin, and below her in the black water the carcass of Cane-robot with dead sensors, its legs folded inwards and the flank plate hanging open
scenes.valle_tre_sagome.background.image: seen from indoors through a large glazed wall: the valley, the ridge in the distance and three quadruped machines identical to Cane-robot coming down towards the house, spaced apart
scenes.valle_tre_sagome.narration.2.imag: compressed telephoto on the ridge: three quadruped machines identical to Cane-robot descending the slope, spaced and coordinated
scenes.soggiorno_finale.background.image: living room with the glass wall smashed through, afternoon light: Laura sitting on the floor with her back against the sofa, soaked to the knees, a flat white cardboard box on her lap and a walkie-talkie beside her
scenes.finale_esterno.background.image_p: exterior day, locked-off wide shot: the glazing of a villa reflecting the white sky, on the lawn three quadruped machines identical to Cane-robot entering the frame, spaced and coordinated
scenes.finale_esterno.narration.3.image_: three quadruped machines identical to Cane-robot standing still in front of a glass-walled house, motionless; on the flank of each one an LED going out, one after another
